::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** November 4, 1899.  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne  
**Manuscript:** MS location unknown. Printed in Coleridge, [<i>Life</i>](other_books/otherbook_40.qmd), 304
:::

My dear [Ellie](people/person_663.qmd)-
Thank you for your letter. We have heard nothing more, and hardly look for anything, and indeed there had been only one letter from [him](people/person_1610.qmd) since he joined [Baden-Powell](people/person_2202.qmd), but that was enough to leave us no doubt that it is himself. [^1] I am so glad he had that year at home after the Matabele War.

He was very much loved here. There was to have been a ‘Social Evening,’ but the people begged to put it off for they could not enjoy it.-

Your affectionate  
C. M. YONGE.

---

[^1]: CMY's nephew George Yonge, killed on 22 October 1899 at Crocodile River, Rhodesia, during the Boer War.
